title: Chapter 447 Kirin'S Strength
content:
Chapter 447 Kirin'S Strength

Suddenly, Ao Qing slowly opened her eyes, and the huge dragon eyes were filled with colorful colors.

"At this time, it seems that the combat power list should be over."

Ao Qing murmured.

When the demons around him heard this, they were silent.

They have reached a critical moment at this moment. If they interrupt now, they may fail. If they are serious, they will be backfired, which will not be worth the loss.

The demons still regretted it if they didn't have the chance to participate in the combat power list.

However, they are not without gains. With Ao Qing's help, the strength of the powerful people of the Tian Yao Clan has been greatly improved.

Not to mention the cultivation level for the time being, the most important thing that the demon clan pays is bloodline.

At this time, they accepted Ao Qing's bloodline inheritance, and the bloodline of the Heavenly Demon in their bodies became increasingly rich. This was not only a brief improvement for them, but also infinite potential.

"Isn't it just a combat power list? This is just the first settlement. When the next combat power list is opened, my Tian Yao Clan will surely shine." The leader of the Tian Yao Clan's tribe remained motionless and said in his heart.

And at this moment, Ao Qing suddenly felt suspicious, with a hint of surprise in his eyes, looking towards the direction of the deserted city.

"What's this breath?"

The monsters in the hall suddenly trembled all over, and the blood in their bodies began to gradually tremble.

"It feels so strange, why do I suddenly want to go to the deserted city?"

"So too, there seems to be a very familiar atmosphere there."

"Wait, I remember this breath!"

At the same time, in the distant deserted city.

There is very little time left before the first settlement of the combat power list. Looking at the glorious achievements of the human race in the combat power list, the other races present felt ashamed of their victory.

Suddenly, a powerful wave rose from not far outside the Huangcheng Square.

Ancient, majestic aura spread out and pounced on all directions.

Under the shocked gaze of everyone, a colorful figure appeared on the deserted city, with clouds and mist floating around, showing auspicious aura.

"That's it, Qilin?"

A strong man with deep knowledge said dazedly.

At this time, all the powerful people of the Heavenly Demon Clan present were already kneeling on the ground, bursting with tears.

Excited and joyful emotions filled the hearts of the demons. Then, the demons cheered in unison: "We wait, welcome the return of our ancestors!"

Qilin and life!

Immediately, the colorful figure suddenly disappeared, and an old man with ordinary white hair and handsome face slowly walked towards the entrance of the square.

Behind him, several powerful men from the Heavenly Demon Clan followed obediently like guards, with a proud expression on their faces.

Hao Yusheng did nothing, but just walked normally on the stone brick floor of the deserted city.

But even so, an invisible sense of oppression filled everyone present.

The space trembled, and several top-notch people suddenly appeared on the field.

They were all guardians of the combat power list. At this moment, they heard reminders from people around them and showed up to meet this senior.

Even the three strong men of the human race are the same.

"Senior Tian Yao, I never expected that you would appear here."

Wu Hui spoke first with a smile on his face.

Hao Yusheng looked slightly and looked at Wu Hui, "Are you the leader of the human race today? It seems that the human race is developing very well now."

"The Heavenly Demon Clan is not bad either." Wu Hui responded.

Hao Yusheng shook his head and smiled, and did not continue the topic.

How the Tiande Clan has developed depends on the human race's expression. Now the human race is powerful, and even if the ancestor of the Tiande Clan comes, it cannot change this ending, because the strength of the human race does not lie in the human race itself, but behind the human race. The deserted city.

Hao and Sheng asked themselves that no matter how powerful the energy is, they cannot shake such a huge creature.

"Are you the ancestor of the Heavenly Demon Clan?"

Just then, a sudden sound suddenly rang.

Everyone present was shocked.

Who is it that he is so disrespectful to the ancestors of the Heavenly Demon Clan. Didn’t he see that the Lord of Wuhui Palace is so respectful and polite?

The powerful people of the Heavenly Demon Clan looked angry and showed their anger.

But when everyone looked at the person talking, they suddenly understood.

The speaker is the strong man of the human race and the madman.

"This lunatic."

Someone sighed in the dark.

Zhan Kuangren looked at Hao Yusheng, the ancestor of the Heavenly Demon Clan, with a strange smile on his lips.

At this time, Hao Yusheng was also watching the war madman, "Young man, when I was dominating the world, the human race was just a small tribe with initial achievements. Even though he is old now and has just recovered his body, he is not a human being. All can be provocative."

Immediately, Hao Yusheng stretched out a hand towards the Zhan Kuangren and said calmly: "Let's take action, give you a chance, remember, it's only once."

As soon as these words came out, everyone was shocked.

Unexpectedly, the ancestor of the Heavenly Demon Clan is even more crazy than the Zhan Madman, but it is understandable. After all, he is the founder of the sect, how can he not be crazy?

only,,

Mo Chou stood up at this time and said, "Senior, please kindly remind me that fighting is not allowed in the deserted city."

"It can be made an exception."

As soon as he finished speaking, Lu Xue's figure appeared in the Huangcheng Square.

When they saw Lu Xue, almost everyone saluted Lu Xue respectfully.

"I've met Senior Lu Xue."

Hao Yusheng glanced at Lu Xue deeply and said softly, "Thank you."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded slightly.

Everyone around quickly retreated to make room for the two fierce men, fearing that the battle would affect them later.

At this time, the war madman could no longer resist the intention of taking action.

Seeing that there was no longer any worries, Zhan Kuangman smiled grimly and exerted force suddenly.

Bang!

With a loud bang, the Zhan Madman rushed out directly towards Hao Yusheng. The strong sonic boom sound shocked the people present with low cultivation and weak faces.

The speed of the war madman was so fast, he rushed to Hao Yusheng in an instant.

As he saw a hand knife mixed with bloodthirsty energy was about to penetrate Hao Yusheng's chest.

The next moment, a auspicious breath surged out, and followed Hao Yusheng's outstretched hand towards the war madman in front of him.

Buzz —

A dazzling white light flashed by.

When everyone opened their eyes again, Zhan Madman was already lying on the ground, his eyes lost.

Hao Yusheng was half-squatting on the ground, pressing his hand on Zhan Madman's chest.

The scene was silent.

Until Hao Yusheng stood up lightly and whispered: "Young man, arrogant, requires ability."

Everyone reacted and immediately took a deep breath.

The Zhan Madman, who is second only to the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace, was subdued by the ancestor of the Heavenly Demon Clan in one turn. Such strength is simply terrifying!

Wu Hui looked at this scene with a slightly solemn expression.

His original intention of not organizing was to make the ancestor of the Heavenly Demon Clan Zhizhi reign the temper of Zhan Madman, but even he did not expect that Zhan Madman would not even hold on for a single round.

What was the move just now?

Not only did Wu Hui not see the clue, but the Zhan Madman defeated by this move is even more so.

Until now, he has not recovered.

I just lost.

He was very dissatisfied, but for some reason, he couldn't even raise his fighting spirit at this moment.
